name: Setup: 3 players hold 4+4+4 cards and the deck holds 18, 30 cards in all (faces random, only counts asserted)
rule_text: When the deck is built, then it has 30 cards: for each of R, G, B, three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s and one 5.

name: Setup: deck_ids and deck_faces are paired lists of equal length (2 players, 20 left)
rule_text: When setup runs, then deck_faces is a shuffle of the 30 faces and deck_ids is #1..#30 in order, with deck_ids[k] paired to deck_faces[k].

name: A discarded card moves with its id and face together; the paired lists keep equal lengths
rule_text: When any card moves, then its ID and face are removed from the same index of their paired lists and moved together, and no other record of the face exists.

name: 2 players: hands of 5, deck_count 20
rule_text: When there are 2 players, then each hand has 5 cards and deck_count starts at 20.

name: 3 players: hands of 4, deck_count 18
rule_text: When there are 3 players, then each hand has 4 cards and deck_count starts at 18.

name: 4 players: hands of 4, deck_count 14
rule_text: When there are 4 players, then each hand has 4 cards and deck_count starts at 14.

name: 3-player deal: each seat holds 4 ids, the deck holds the remaining 18 ids
rule_text: When dealing with 3 players, then seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and deck_ids holds #13-#30.

name: deck_count tracks deck_ids after two draws
rule_text: When any step ends, then deck_count equals the number of entries in deck_ids.

name: Hints are offered from other seats' faces, never about one's own hand
rule_text: When a seat views the table, then it sees every seat's hand_ids and every other seat's hand_faces, but never its own hand_faces.

name: Start state: piles 0, 8 hints, 3 fuses, score 0, empty discard pile, no turns played
rule_text: When the game starts, then the piles are 0, hint_tokens is 8, fuses is 3, team_score is 0, discard_pile and action_log are empty, turns_played is 0, final_turns_left is -1 and active_seat is 1.

name: First turn: only seat 1 is asked
rule_text: When a turn begins, then only the active seat is asked; seats act in order 1..num_players and then seat 1 again.

name: Seats act in order 1, 2, 3
rule_text: When a turn begins, then only the active seat is asked; seats act in order 1..num_players and then seat 1 again.

name: The active seat may play or discard only its own cards
rule_text: When a turn begins, then the active seat's options are 'PLAY #id' and 'DISCARD #id' for each id in its hand, and every other seat's legal_options is empty.

name: With 1 hint token, only hints matching the target's cards are offered
rule_text: When hint_tokens >= 1, then the active seat is also offered 'HINT s v' for each other seat s and each v in R,G,B,1-5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand; when hint_tokens is 0, no HINT is offered.

name: With 0 hint tokens no hint is offered; the seat discards and regains one
rule_text: When hint_tokens >= 1, then the active seat is also offered 'HINT s v' for each other seat s and each v in R,G,B,1-5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand; when hint_tokens is 0, no HINT is offered.

name: A hint costs 1 token and moves or draws no card
rule_text: When a seat hints, then hint_tokens falls by 1, action_log gains a line naming giver, receiver, value and every matching ID in the receiver's hand, and no card moves or is drawn.

name: Discarding with an empty deck removes the card from both hand lists and draws nothing
rule_text: When a seat plays or discards #id, then the card at #id's index in its hand_ids is removed from both hand_ids and hand_faces.

name: Playing R1 onto an empty red pile succeeds: pile_red 1, team_score 1, every total 1
rule_text: When a played card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile, then that pile becomes the rank, team_score rises by 1, and action_log records the success with the face.

name: A successful 5 with 5 hint tokens raises them to 6
rule_text: When a 5 is played successfully and hint_tokens is below 8, then hint_tokens rises by 1; at 8 it stays 8.

name: A successful 5 with 8 hint tokens leaves them at 8
rule_text: When a 5 is played successfully and hint_tokens is below 8, then hint_tokens rises by 1; at 8 it stays 8.

name: Playing G2 onto an empty green pile fails: fuses 2, card to discard pile, piles and score unchanged
rule_text: When a play fails, then fuses falls by exactly 1, '#id=face' is appended to discard_pile, the piles and team_score are unchanged, and action_log records the failure with the face.

name: Discarding with 5 hint tokens: card to discard pile, tokens 6
rule_text: When a seat discards, then '#id=face' is appended to discard_pile, hint_tokens rises by 1 to at most 8 (8 stays 8), and action_log records the discard with the face.

name: Discarding with 8 hint tokens leaves them at 8
rule_text: When a seat discards, then '#id=face' is appended to discard_pile, hint_tokens rises by 1 to at most 8 (8 stays 8), and action_log records the discard with the face.

name: After a play the player draws the top deck card: hand back to 4, deck down by 1
rule_text: When a seat plays or discards and deck_ids is not empty, then the front entries of deck_ids and deck_faces move together to the end of that seat's hand_ids and hand_faces.

name: 2 players, last card drawn on turn 1: the game ends after 3 turns
rule_text: When a draw makes deck_count 0 and final_turns_left is -1, then final_turns_left is set to num_players + 1.

name: End of turn: every total becomes team_score and turns_played rises by 1
rule_text: When a turn ends, then every seat's total is set to team_score, turns_played rises by 1, final_turns_left falls by 1 if it is above 0, and active_seat passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

name: After seat 3 the turn passes back to seat 1
rule_text: When a turn ends, then every seat's total is set to team_score, turns_played rises by 1, final_turns_left falls by 1 if it is above 0, and active_seat passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).

name: A failed play on the last fuse ends the game with score 0: no seat wins
rule_text: When fuses reaches 0 at the end of a turn, then the game ends.

name: Playing the last 5 reaches 15 and ends the game: all seats win, a hint token is regained
rule_text: When team_score reaches 15 at the end of a turn, then the game ends.

name: 3 players, last card drawn on turn 1: everyone gets one more turn, the game ends after 4 turns
rule_text: When final_turns_left reaches 0 at the end of a turn, then the game ends, so every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied.

name: The 40th turn ends the game
rule_text: When turns_played reaches 40, then the game ends.

name: A turn is a single action by the active seat; other seats are offered nothing
rule_text: When the game is played, then there is no message phase and players communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.

name: Game ends on the third fuse with team_score 10: all seats win
rule_text: When the game ends with team_score >= 10, then every seat wins; with team_score below 10, no seat wins, even if the game ended on the third fuse.

name: Game ends on turn 40 with team_score 9: no seat wins
rule_text: When the game ends with team_score >= 10, then every seat wins; with team_score below 10, no seat wins, even if the game ended on the third fuse.
